Functions
cpct_asicPageConnect

Connect Asic Page to get access to Asic registers and memory

C Definition

void cpct_asicPageConnect();

Assembly call:

call cpct_asicPageConnect_asm
Details

Get access to Asic page memory configuration from 0x4000 to 0x7FFF. All code in this area will be hidden and will no be readable.  To restore the memory page, use cpct_asicPageDisconnect function.
